data.name: Last Dance
data.detailed_description:
To win against a friend in Last Dance, you’ll need a cunning plan and better execution. Before each round is a “Planning Phase” where both players scrub through a timeline and select board tiles for their traps to appear on at certain times. During the game itself, you’ll have reminders of where your future traps are shortly before they appear, however you’ll need to make sure that you keep them in mind for long before. You’ll need to land skill-shots, a hook and a push, to move your enemy where you want them to go. You could also go for a tricky approach and try to psychologically influence their movement by playing in strange and unexpected ways!

  • Battle friends or random players online in a dreamy gothic arena.

  • Use "Hook" and "Push" abilities paired with hundreds of possible trap placements.

  • Mechanics that reward both strategic planning and combat execution.

Are you ready to join the deadliest dance?

We highly recommend joining the discord to find people to play with and to chat with devs!

data.short_description: A 1v1 strategy and fighting game that relies on careful planning and quick instinct. Before the round, plan for traps to appear during the fight at specific places and times. You’ll need a good plan AND good execution to win, lest your enemy knock you into your own traps! Grab a friend and fight!
